notes: BW25113 carrying pKT-CNP (rat CNPase, heterologous) vs pKT-CNP-inact (catalytically inactive variant, called control). The inactive-variant strain is treated like an empty-vector control (genotype_class reference, is_control true); both arms induced with aTc. Medium M9 + glucose + casamino acids = minimal_plus_hydrolysate. Growth phase 'logarithmic' (stated), OD600 0.5-0.6.

base_medium.q: M9 minimal medium (supplemented with 0.4% glucose, 0.2% casamino acids, and 100 µg/mL carbenicillin)

medium_class.q: M9 minimal medium (supplemented with 0.4% glucose, 0.2% casamino acids, and 100 µg/mL carbenicillin)

amino_acids_supplied.q: M9 minimal medium (supplemented with 0.4% glucose, 0.2% casamino acids, and 100 µg/mL carbenicillin)

carbon_source.q: M9 minimal medium (supplemented with 0.4% glucose, 0.2% casamino acids, and 100 µg/mL carbenicillin)

growth_temperature.q: at 37°C overnight (~18 h) with shaking at 200-225 rpm

culture_mode.q: subcultured 1:100 into 10 mL of the same medium and incubated under the same conditions

oxygen.q: at 37°C overnight (~18 h) with shaking at 200-225 rpm

inducer_added.q: All cultures subsequently were treated with anhydrotetracycline (25 ng/mL) to induce protein expression from the pKT vector.

treatment.q: Global transcript levels in E. coli expressing CNPase were compared to levels in control cells expressing a catalytically inactive variant of the enzyme

transcription_arrested.q: Global transcript levels in E. coli expressing CNPase were compared to levels in control cells expressing a catalytically inactive variant of the enzyme

mixed_organism.q: Global transcript levels in E. coli expressing CNPase were compared to levels in control cells expressing a catalytically inactive variant of the enzyme

rrna_removal.q: Ribosomal transcripts were depleted from 2 ug of total RNA

assay_class.q: libraries were generated following Illumina's Scripseq V2 Complete- Bacterial library prep kits

global_regulator_perturbed.q: heterologous expression of a 2',3'-cyclic nucleotide phosphodiesterase (CNPase)
